description: AICTIONBOT™ early warning check by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit frame T31 (supplier resilience) and the supplier check of the Werkbank. For each supplier the user passes the warning signals observed (L-01 asks for prepayment or shorter payment terms, L-02 partial deliveries and postponed dates pile up, L-03 leadership changes or contacts hard to reach, L-04 complaints rising on a proven part, L-08 high price increase shortly after an agreement, L-09 new owner, office, name or bank account, L-10 insolvency filed) and amplifiers (L-05 own tools at the supplier without a list, L-06 single source for a critical part, L-07 own volume is a large share of the supplier's revenue). Returns per supplier a light: yellow for one signal or several in the same field; red for signals from two fields, a signal with an amplifier, price jump with prepayment, L-09 with a sanctions match, or L-10; green if no signal is given (which does not mean safe). With the reasons, what to do per rule, the date to check again, and a screening of each name against the EU, UN, US and UK sanctions lists (up to 15 names per call; set screen_sanctions false for up to 25 without screening). Rules signed off by Dario Kulić. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

screen_sanctions.description: Screen each name against the sanctions lists. Default true.

suppliers.description: One object per supplier: name, signals (array of rule ids such as ["L-01", "L-06"]); instead of signals the keys prepayment, delays, leadership_change, complaints_rising, price_jump, new_owner_or_bank, insolvency, tools_without_list, single_source, high_dependency may be set to yes.

name: screen_supplier_risk
title: Early warning check for a supplier list: red, yellow or green by KULIC Advisory's rules L-01 to L-10, plus sanctions screening
